| 能力组合 | 添加必备／优先 Skill、优先插件与优先 MCP。必备 Skill 每份工作单开始时加载；优先 Skill 在任务匹配时按需读取。 |
| 认知记忆 | 上传专业资料，浏览知识关系、文章和原文，管理自动归档设置。 |

“AI 智填”使用当前草稿的姓名和模型，生成结果不会自动保存为正式配置。选中某个插件或 MCP 只表达使用偏好，不会自动安装、连接或授予权限；需要先在 DSH 中准备好相应能力。
dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 1. 创建或调整专业员工：员工自我介绍应简洁说明姓名、岗位和可提供的帮助，不主动展示项目/员工 ID、内部路径或运行协议；必要的工具路由资料保留在内部执行上下文。用户明确要求技术排查时，只提供相关的非敏感信息。

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 2. 组建团队：在 **团队** 中引入已配置的员工，设置团队内名称及上下级关系。员工定义可被多个团队复用，同一岗位也可作为不同成员加入团队。

团队的 **资料管理员** 开关控制团队共享及成员长期知识的使用与整理。共享资料管理员跟随团队唯一负责人的模型；员工私库使用该员工的模型和独立整理提示，不额外占用业务岗位。

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 3. 定义工作流：在 **工作流** 中新建或编辑流程，先引入团队，再为每一步选择该团队内的负责人。当前编辑器提供步骤说明、交付内容、验收标准和退回目标；输入资料与依赖可写入步骤说明：

- **步骤说明与输入**：这一阶段要解决什么问题、依据什么资料。
- **交付内容**：应产生的文件、结果或说明。
- **验收标准**：如何判断完成，哪些情况需要退回。
- **不合格退回目标**：本步骤或之前的有效步骤。

保存后，顺序与返工路径会在流程图中显示。步骤尝试次数和运行参数保持有界，避免没有结束条件的重试。

员工和团队引入项目时保存独立配置。当前工作流库则是流程定义的来源：编辑通过版本校验同步到项目引用，项目继续独立保存人员绑定、进度与交付历史。涉及已有交付的破坏性修改会被限制；契约变更可能使后续结果需要重新验证。不要把“编辑模板”理解为自动重做已执行任务。

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 4. 在项目对话中选择工作流：**Chat 目录例外：** 不显示或执行工作流。普通消息保持原生聊天；行首输入 `@` 可从自由职业人库选择单个员工，确认发送后创建或复用独立员工并打开独立工作单，无需团队或工作流。旧流程记录保留但不接管 Chat。识别依据为目录名而非展示标题，详见[Chat 工作区规则](docs/architecture/chat-workspace.md)。

**选择对话员工：** Chat 顶部与项目负责人相同的位置显示“选择对话员工”。默认不选员工；点击后只列员工姓名，选择即常驻当前对话，后续消息交给该员工。选择“无”可取消，其他对话不受影响，刷新后保留选择。

**临时调用：** 在输入框输入 `@` 并选择员工，只由该员工处理当前轮次，留在同一个对话，支持原生附件、历史和流式输出；不会改变顶部常驻选择。下一轮恢复常驻员工，未选择常驻员工则使用原生助手。员工按自身岗位、模型、技能和授权知识工作，不再在菜单中额外选择“轻咨询／执行任务”。

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 专业认知与记忆如何工作：每位员工可以拥有自己的专业资料和可见记忆，团队也可以形成共享知识。专业认知不只是一段角色提示词，还包含能回到原文核对的资料、知识重组和关系结构。

| 层次 | 内容 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A · 原始资料 | 上传原件、阅读文本、版本、哈希与来源 | 核实原文、精确引用、比较变化与冲突。 |

text:
dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · 专业认知与记忆如何工作：**资料管理：** 在“专业知识”中上传 PDF、DOCX、UTF-8 文本、Markdown、JSON、CSV、YAML 或日志。单文件最多 **6 MiB**，每次最多 **8 个文件／12 MiB**。原件与提取文本分别保存；扫描 PDF 和图片文字不做隐式 OCR。抽取或整理失败会保留已归档资料，并提供状态与重试。

**四类知识：** 专业知识、任务档案、复盘经验、工作约束。后三类有独立自动归档开关；关闭分类开关停止后续自动收录，已有资料仍可阅读，重新开启不会立即补扫。团队资料管理员总开关关闭时，则停止该团队及成员长期知识的读取、写入和整理，保留数据。

**增量整理：** 来源更新后只处理变更及必要依赖，保留未受影响内容；重复上传或无变化重试不产生新的模型编纂。自动资料按任务稳定阶段合批，首次启动只本地归档。需要编纂时会通过 DSH 模型服务调用模型，可能产生模型费用；打开已有图谱或阅读文章不会因此发起编纂。

text: dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：Employees can maintain their own references and visible memory, while teams build shared knowledge. Professional context includes source-backed information and relationships, alongside role instructions.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：| Layer | Content | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A · Sources | Original uploads, readable text, versions, hashes, provenance | Verify details, cite exact evidence, compare changes and conflicts. |
| B · Synthesis | Organized articles and explanations with source references | Read relevant professional detail; model synthesis remains a candidate. |
| C · Navigation and relationships | Overviews, concepts, entities, evidenced semantic relationships | Find relevant material, then read B or A as needed. |

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：Search, pan, zoom, expand related concepts, and read articles and original evidence alongside the graph. Edges represent evidenced semantic relationships; sharing a source does not create a relationship. Private, shared, and project libraries retain their scope boundaries even though they use one shared knowledge program.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：**Uploads:** PDF, DOCX, UTF-8 text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, YAML, and logs. Limits are **6 MiB per file**, **8 files / 12 MiB per batch**. Originals and extracted text are stored separately. Scanned PDFs and image text do not receive implicit OCR. Failed extraction or organization preserves archived material with status and retry support.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：**Categories:** professional knowledge, task archives, retrospective experience, and working constraints. The last three have independent automatic archive switches. Disabling a category stops future automatic admission while existing knowledge remains readable; reenabling does not immediately backfill. Disabling the team librarian stops shared and member long-term reads, writes, and organization while preserving data.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：**Incremental organization:** changes process only affected sources and necessary dependencies, preserving unaffected content. Duplicate uploads or unchanged retries do not generate fresh model compilation. Automatic material is batched at stable task stages; initial startup performs local archiving only. Compilation uses DSH model services and may incur model costs. Browsing existing graphs or articles does not itself trigger compilation.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：Business conversations use available knowledge or pending source indexes without waiting for cold-start compilation. Failed and cancelled attempts are archived locally; they no longer trigger paid synthesis every time. Accepted results, explicit knowledge changes, uploads and manual requests retain incremental processing. The knowledge view exposes recent compilation attempts, call counts and reported usage; missing reports remain unknown.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：**Evidence and confirmation:** model proposals, temporary chat, and unaccepted artifacts do not automatically become confirmed long-term facts. Retrospectives distinguish observations, evidence, causal hypotheses, recommendations, and verification steps; they do not confirm causes, modify Skills, or execute recommendations on their own. Conflicting versions and sources remain traceable; semantic conflict detection is limited by the supplied evidence and model capabilities.

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Professional knowledge and memory：See [team knowledge](docs/architecture/team-knowledge.md), [incremental processing](docs/architecture/incremental-knowledge.md), and [shared LLM Wiki](docs/architecture/shared-llm-wiki.md).

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Native context, cache reuse, and usage：Stable role rules and required skill bodies are supplied once with content versions; task knowledge has a separate snapshot. Tools and skills use DSH's native registration, catalog and message-update mechanisms, without a second skill catalog. None adds no current employee context or business tools; skill summaries visible in the native catalog still count as input.
section: Native context, cache reuse, and usage

text: dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Native context, cache reuse, and usage：DeepSeek decides whether a complete prefix can be reused. Changing models, definitions, authorization or retained history may require rebuilding part of the cache. Cached input still occupies context and is metered. Delivery details distinguish uncached input, cache reads/writes, output and authoritative provider totals; missing usage is never presented as a free call.
section: Native context, cache reuse, and usage

text: dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Native context, cache reuse, and usage：Version 0.2.1 removes the additional fixed 120,000 cumulative business-token cutoff by default. Native context capacity and compaction remain DSH-owned, while step/time/delegation protections remain. Advanced configuration `maxTreeTokens: 0` disables the extra cutoff; a positive value opts into a metered business-run-tree limit including cached input and output. It is neither a monetary cap nor a shared knowledge-compilation limit. See the [combined analysis, remediation and verification](docs/audits/2026-10-26-runtime-context-remediation.md).

dsh-plugin-composable-workforce README · Frequently asked questions：- **Do I have to use the software team?** No. It is an editable starting point. Create employees, teams, and workflows for your own domain.
- **Why did upgrading not add six roles?** Defaults are created only for new state. Existing profiles are neither overwritten nor silently reseeded. Configure roles manually or import reviewed templates.
- **Why does selecting an MCP server not make it callable?** Selection is a preference. Install, configure, and connect the actual service in DSH and check native permissions.
- **Why is knowledge pending or failed?** Archiving and model compilation are separate. Check the lead/employee model, librarian switch, and processing status, then retry.
- **Does removing an employee delete project history?** Library removal archives and hides the definition, retaining existing instances and records; there is currently no one-click restore. Removing a template is separate from uninstalling the plugin.
